_note: Round 56: the deep's reaches (scripts/Reach.gd builds them, scripts/ReachZone.gd and ReachHeart.gd bring them to life, scripts/systems/Reaches.gd remembers them). Robert, 2026-10-05: 'give the world more depth, more ground to cover, more diverse.' Every dungeon floor grows a REACH: a wide natural region past the edge of its map, joined by a winding tunnel -- a different land from the floor around it (its own ground, walls, light, air, things growing, things living), with a heart at its far end where a warden keeps what the reach gathered. Deeper floors grow two. Same floor, same reaches, every visit (seeded by the floor). The level files on the box are never touched. Every number here; Dev rewrites the names and words (brief reaches).

glowcap.name: The Glowcap Wood
glowcap.desc: Mushrooms as tall as houses, their caps lit from inside. The air is thick and sweet and full of slow green motes.

keepsake.name: Glowcap Lantern-Cap
keepsake.desc: A cap that never stops glowing: you see 2 metres further in the dark, and wounds close 0.3 a second faster.

underlake.name: The Underlake
underlake.desc: A black lake under the rock, so still it holds the cave's lights twice. Old stone causeways run from island to island.

keepsake.name: Underlake Pearl
keepsake.desc: Cold and perfectly round: +5% qi from sitting, and a better chance of a big catch (+4%).

crystal.name: The Crystal Hollows
crystal.desc: Crystal grows out of every wall here, in spears and clusters, and hums when you walk past. The light comes from inside the stone.

keepsake.name: Humming Shard
keepsake.desc: It hums before a blow lands: you slip 2% of blows, +3% jewelcrafting success.

rootcathedral.name: The Root Cathedral
rootcathedral.desc: The roots of something enormous on the surface have broken through the roof and grown down in arches. Pale light leaks through where they came in.

keepsake.name: Root-Knot Charm
keepsake.desc: Heavy as a stone: +4% health, and wounds close 0.3 a second faster.

emberrift.name: The Ember Rift
emberrift.desc: The rock splits open on rivers of slow fire. Black stone pillars, cracked and glowing, hold the roof up. The heat makes the air shake.

keepsake.name: Rift Coal
keepsake.desc: It never cools: your blows burn (1), +3% smithing success.

ossuary.name: The Ossuary Fields
ossuary.desc: Every one of the deep's dead seems to have been carried here and laid down. Skulls in niches, bones in drifts, statues no one remembers.

keepsake.name: Keeper's Tooth
keepsake.desc: From the Ossuary Keeper: each kill gives back 2 health.

frostgallery.name: The Frost Gallery
frostgallery.desc: Cold air pours down from somewhere above. Pools have frozen solid, columns of ice stand where water once fell, and snow drifts down out of the dark.

sunkencity.name: The Sunken Street
sunkencity.desc: A whole street of some old city, swallowed into the rock: broken columns, toppled statues, flagstones worn by feet a thousand years gone.

keepsake.name: Watchman's Seal
keepsake.desc: A city's mark: +5% chance of a second share of loot.

stormchasm.name: The Storm Chasm
stormchasm.desc: Lightning lives down here. It crawls over tall black spires and leaves the air sharp and blue; the floor is scorched in branching patterns.

keepsake.name: Fulgurite Charm
keepsake.desc: Glass made by lightning: your hands move 3% faster.

oldworkings.name: The Old Workings
oldworkings.desc: Somebody mined here for generations, then left in a hurry: props and carts, rails into the dark, seams still glittering in the walls.

keepsake.name: Miner's Lamp
keepsake.desc: Still has oil in it: +1 to everything you gather, +1 sight.
